steps.message: I have successfully fixed the issue where `Text.render` yielded an empty `Segment('')` when the `Text` object was empty but an `end` string was provided.

The bug was caused by `Text.render` yielding `Segment(text)` even when `text` was an empty string, provided that no spans were present. This resulted in an extra empty segment before the `end` segment. I fixed this by adding a check to only yield `Segment(text)` if `text` is not empty.
